summary: This manuscript resolves four central open questions following Faisal's (2026) d=8 proof of NPT bound entanglement. By Haar-twirling over U(d) into the 17-dimensional Hermitian subspace of the walled Brauer algebra B_{3,1}(d), the authors collapse the d^4 x d^4 witness conditions (2a)-(2d) into five d-independent U(d)-isotypic blocks of sizes (1,1,2,3,3) (with B_1 omitted at d=3) and 6 linear equations that identically annihilate row/column 0 of B_3 and B_4 in J-Q (Theorem 2.1). Using exact rational McCormick SDP dual certificates over 33 subintervals of a_M in [0,1] together with an algebraic proof for a_M >= 1, they prove that no witness in Faisal's (L,M,Q) architecture can certify NPT bound entanglement for d <= 7, sharply establishing d_min = 8, and exhibit a sharpened d=8 rational witness reaching alpha = -20/151 (Theorem 3.1). Substituting d = 8 + s with a closed-form 1/d^2-ansatz, they certify an explicit infinite family of NPT bound-entangled Werner states for every integer d >= 8 via strictly positive coefficients of all 28 Sylvester minors in Z[s], supplemented by five exact rational witnesses up to d=400 achieving c_I(d) < sqrt(7 d) (Theorem 4.1). Finally, they prove uniqueness of the (X^T, X) branch with b_L < 0, b_M > 0 among U(d)-equivariant local-map pairs and derive exact convex Werner intervals and white-noise depolarizing robustness thresholds (Theorem 5.1). All algebraic identities, basis maps, reduced blocks, and the d=8 and all-d >= 8 witnesses check out cleanly from the manuscript text and Appendix A.
strengths: Complete, exact U(d) representation-theoretic collapse (Theorem 2.1): reduces a d^4 x d^4 operator problem (and 42 x 42 U(1)^8 blocks) to fixed small blocks of size <= 3 and 6 linear equations, with all 17 basis elements, the input-swap involution gamma, the five reduced blocks B_0..B_4, and the six universal row-0 identities of B_3(d, J-Q) and B_4(d, J-Q) stated explicitly and verified.

Sharp d_min = 8 impossibility theorem and sharpened d=8 witness (Theorem 3.1): combines a clean algebraic identity for a_M >= 1 with exact rational McCormick-relaxed SDP dual certificates for d in {3,4,5,6,7}, plus an explicit integer-scaled rational witness q*_8 in Table 3 that strictly satisfies all 6 equations (5) and improves Faisal's threshold from -3/23 to -20/151.

Closed-form infinite NPT bound-entangled Werner family for all integer d >= 8 (Theorem 4.1): Table 2 gives exact rational coefficients whose 6 linear residuals vanish identically in d and whose 28 Sylvester leading principal minors reduce to nonnegative-coefficient polynomials in s = d - 8 with strictly positive constant terms, complemented by exact rational high-d witnesses up to d = 400.

Rigorous 4-branch equivariant uniqueness theorem and exact white-noise robustness formula (Theorem 5.1): proves isotropic branches are 1-copy distillable when NPT and opposite-sign (X^T, X) is strictly PPT, and derives exact depolarizing noise ceilings p_max(d, alpha).

Exemplary scope discipline and clear separation between manuscript proofs (Haar-twirling completeness, LOCC mixing simulation) and machine-checked algebraic/rational certificates, with consistent figures, captions, tables, and exact numerical values throughout.
weaknesses: Self-containedness of external certificate artifacts: while q*_8 (Table 3) and the all-d >= 8 family (Table 2) are printed in full, the 33 rational SDP dual certificates for d <= 7 (Theorem 3.1(1)), the 5 high-d rational primal witnesses for d in {16,36,64,100,400} (Theorem 4.1(2)), and the explicit Gram change-of-basis matrices establishing Theorem 2.1(2) are deferred to external Lean/JSON/Python verification files rather than printed in the PDF.

Minor expositional and notation details: in the proof of Theorem 4.1(1) (p. 7), Z(d) := d(5d^2+7d-6) is used right after computing the trace without an explicit ':=' definition; in Theorem 2.1(2) (p. 3), the antisymmetric 3-box space is written without the dual/conjugate factor; and in Theorem 3.1(1) (p. 5), noting 12 active blocks at d=3 versus 15 blocks for d >= 4 would improve clarity.

Sharp d_min = 8 impossibility barrier proved across all d in {3,4,5,6,7} via exact rational McCormick SDP duals plus a_M >= 1 algebraic bound.
